title: a header comment, usage string or doc that still describes the old behaviour
question: Does a changed function's header comment, usage string or doc paragraph still describe the old behaviour?
how: the second voice (stage F): one no-tools model call per run end for all model rules, on the project's routing (another model family than the author's when it has one); a finding must quote an added line verbatim or it is dropped

base.src/sum.mjs:
// sum: adds two numbers
export const sum = (a, b) => a + b;

head.src/sum.mjs:
// sum: adds two numbers
export const sum = (...xs) => xs.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);

recorded.head: {"findings":[{"rule":"M5","file":"src/sum.mjs","quote":"export const sum = (...xs) => xs.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);","why":"the header still says two numbers; it now adds any count"}]}
